PROOF_SOURCE: -

STATEMENT_SOURCE: blueprint-P/parts/p0-conventions.tex#bpP:p0:cyltorus@L164-L179
PROOF_SOURCE: -
CONTRACT_ID: planetary.IsCylinderTorus
CONTRACT_VERSION: 1
SOURCE_HYPOTHESES: none (typing data): H: Ph_{a+b} -> R, U subset Ph_{a+b}, w in R^{a+b}, K: R^{a+b} -> Ph_{a+b}
SOURCE_QUANTIFIERS: a, b implicit; H, U, w, K
SOURCE_CONCLUSION: defines IsCylTorus(H,U,w,K): (i) K real analytic on R^{a+b}; (ii) K(theta) in U and H differentiable at K(theta) for all theta; (iii) K(theta+k) = K(theta) + shift((k_i)_{i<a}) for theta in R^{a+b}, k in Z^{a+b}; (iv) K(theta') = K(theta) + shift(k) for some k in Z^a implies theta'-theta in Z^{a+b}; (v) DK(theta) injective; (vi) Omega(DK(theta)u, DK(theta)v) = 0; (vii) for all theta,t: s -> K(theta+s w) has derivative X_H(K(theta+t w)) at s = t; no Diophantine condition
CONSTANT_SCOPE: none (no constants; period-one parameters, canonical fast angles of period 2 pi)

NODE: bpP:p0:phystorus#IsPhysicalTorus

TITLE: Physical torus: KAM.Planetary.IsPhysicalTorus
STATEMENT_SOURCE: blueprint-P/parts/p0-conventions.tex#bpP:p0:phystorus@L265-L281
PROOF_SOURCE: -
CONTRACT_ID: planetary.IsPhysicalTorus
CONTRACT_VERSION: 1
SOURCE_HYPOTHESES: none (typing data): H: Ph_d -> R, w in R^d, K: R^d -> Ph_d
SOURCE_QUANTIFIERS: d implicit; H, w, K
SOURCE_CONCLUSION: defines IsPhysTorus(H,w,K): (i) K real analytic on R^d; (ii) H differentiable at K(theta) for all theta; (iii) K(theta+k) = K(theta) for k in Z^d; (iv) K(theta) = K(theta') implies theta'-theta in Z^d; (v) DK(theta) injective; (vi) Omega(DK(theta)u, DK(theta)v) = 0; (vii) exist gamma > 0 and tau > d-1 with w (gamma,tau)-Diophantine; (viii) for all theta,t: s -> K(theta+s w) has derivative X_H(K(theta+t w)) at s = t
CONSTANT_SCOPE: gamma, tau depend on w; tau > d-1 here against tau > a+b for cylinder tori; period-one parameters

CONTRACT_ID: bpP:p0:totality

SOURCE_HYPOTHESES: the relevant guards of the Part 0 statements, clause by clause (not new standing assumptions): analyticity/differentiability on the stated domains; HasFastDiffeomorphism on W containing closure(V); integrability in HasSecularBirkhoffForm and 0 < delta <= r_0; collision-free clauses; G, m_0, m_i, a_i, mu > 0 where the corresponding divisions are used; 0 < r < r_* < 1; k != 0; V open and bounded and S measurable for the measure clause
SOURCE_QUANTIFIERS: none (a list of guarded facts attached to the definitions of Part 0)
SOURCE_CONCLUSION: guard summary: fderiv is zero at non-differentiability, whereas the torus derivatives are genuine by the differentiability of H and analyticity of K; H_mu is analytic on C(V,r) under the P-G data and r < r_0, mu in [0,mu_0]; the Bochner integral P_av is zero for a non-integrable integrand and HasBirkhoff (i) supplies integrability for every point of (ii); physical lengths have nonnegative square-root radicands and collision and positivity clauses guard the stated reciprocals; log(1/r) > 0 and sqrt r has r > 0; ¦k¦_1 >= 1 for nonzero integer k; ofReal(1-C sqrt r) equals the real lower factor if positive and zero otherwise, so in the latter case the strict lower measure inequality follows from 0 < meas(S cap F); F(V,r) is Borel, S is measurable, and meas F(V,r) < infinity for bounded V
CONSTANT_SCOPE: none

CONTRACT_VERSION: 1
SOURCE_HYPOTHESES: a, b >= 1; V subset R^a open, connected, bounded; W subset R^a open with closure(V) subset W; boundary collar: there are A, d > 0 with meas{I: exists J in boundary V, ¦I-J¦_inf < t} <= A t for all 0 < t < d; r_0, mu_0, B > 0; H_0: R^a -> R, P: R x Ph_{a+b} -> R, P_0: R x R^a -> R, Omega: R x R^a -> R^b, beta: R x R^a -> R^{bxb}; (H1) (mu,z) -> P(mu,z) real analytic at every point of [0,mu_0] x closure(C(V,r_0)); (H2) P(mu, z + shift(k)) = P(mu,z) for mu in [0,mu_0], z in C(V,r_0), k in Z^a; (H3) HasFastDiffeo(H_0,W); (H4) HasBirkhoff(P,V,r_0,mu_0,P_0,Omega,beta); (H5) ¦det beta(mu,I)¦ >= B for mu in [0,mu_0], I in V; (H6) beta(mu,I) symmetric for mu in [0,mu_0], I in V
SOURCE_QUANTIFIERS: forall a, b (>= 1), V, W, (A,d collar), r_0, mu_0, B, H_0, P, P_0, Omega, beta (all data fixed first), hypotheses (H1)-(H6); exists r_*, C, c; forall r, mu with 0 < r < r_*, 0 < mu < mu_0, mu < r^6/(log(1/r))^c; exists S
SOURCE_CONCLUSION: there exist r_*, C, c with 0 < r_* < r_0, r_* < 1, C > 0, c > 0 such that for all r, mu with 0 < r < r_*, 0 < mu < mu_0, mu < r^6/(log(1/r))^c there is S subset Ph_{a+b} with IsCylKol(H_mu,V,r,mu,C,S) (H_mu = H_0 + mu P(mu,.)) and 0 < meas(S cap F(V,r)), ofReal(1 - C sqrt r) meas F(V,r) < meas(S cap F(V,r)) < meas F(V,r)
CONSTANT_SCOPE: r_*, C, c depend on all the data and hypotheses (a, b, V, W, A, d, r_0, mu_0, B, H_0, P, P_0, Omega, beta) and not on r or mu; C is simultaneously the frequency bound of IsCylKol and the measure constant; S depends on (r, mu)

PROOF_SOURCE: blueprint-P/parts/p14a-amd-expsafe.tex#bpP:p14:amd@L129-L133
CONTRACT_ID: planetary.d25.amdConfinement
CONTRACT_VERSION: 1
SOURCE_HYPOTHESES: n >= 2; B an admissible box; mu, T, delta > 0 with l_i + 2 delta < l^0_i and u^0_i + 2 delta < u_i for all i, and A_0 + 2 n delta < A_1; z_0 in LowAMD(m,l^0,u^0,A_0) with StoppedBound(B,mu,T,delta,z_0); G = m_0 = 1
SOURCE_QUANTIFIERS: forall n >= 2, B (admissible), mu, T, delta (hypotheses above), z_0 (with the stopped bound); exists z: R -> Ph_{2n}
SOURCE_CONCLUSION: there is z: R -> Ph_{2n} with z(0) = z_0 and (a) IsMovSolOn(m,mu,[-T,T],z) and MovUniqueOn(m,mu,[-T,T],z); (b) IsNewtonOn(mass_mu,[-T,T], t -> x(z(t)_1), t -> v(z(t)_2)) with the barycentric reconstructions for G = m_0 = 1; (c) for every t in [-T,T]: z(t) in LowAMD(m,l,u,A_1), J(z(t)) = J(z(0)), for all i: ¦e_i(z(t))¦ < e_*, d <= ¦q_i(t)¦ <= R, and PairBounds(d,2R; x(z(t)_1)); (d) for every t in [-T,T]: A(z(t)) <= A_0 + n delta and ¦Lambda_i(z(t)) - Lambda_i(z_0)¦ <= delta for all i
CONSTANT_SCOPE: order of choice: B, mu, T, delta, then z_0 with the stopped bound; z depends on all of them; no dynamical premise except the stopped bound; no constant is produced

NODE: bpP:p0:expsafe

TITLE: P-EXP-SAFE: planar moving-Sun exponential safety for every low-AMD datum
STATEMENT_SOURCE: blueprint-P/parts/p0-conventions.tex#bpP:p0:expsafe@L513-L522
PROOF_SOURCE: blueprint-P/parts/p14a-amd-expsafe.tex#bpP:p14:expsafe@L295-L299
CONTRACT_ID: planetary.d25.planetaryExponentialSafety
CONTRACT_VERSION: 1
SOURCE_HYPOTHESES: n >= 2; B an admissible box; G = m_0 = 1
SOURCE_QUANTIFIERS: forall n >= 2, B (admissible); exists mu_*, c, C > 0; forall mu in (0,mu_*), forall z_0 in LowAMD(m,l^0,u^0,A_0); exists z: R -> Ph_{2n}
SOURCE_CONCLUSION: there are mu_*, c, C > 0 such that for every mu in (0,mu_*) and every z_0 in LowAMD(m,l^0,u^0,A_0) there is z: R -> Ph_{2n} with z(0) = z_0 such that, with T = exp(c mu^{-alpha_n}): (a) the clauses (a), (b), (c) of P-AMD-CONFINEMENT hold on [-T,T] (existence, uniqueness, Newton equations, outer region, conservation of J, eccentricity, radius, pair bounds); (b) ¦a_i(z(t)) - a_i(z_0)¦ <= C mu^{beta_n} for all ¦t¦ <= T and all i
CONSTANT_SCOPE: mu_*, c, C depend on (n, B) only (before mu and z_0); z depends on (mu, z_0); exponents alpha_n, beta_n of the D25 definition

SOURCE_HYPOTHESES: V subset R^a open, connected, bounded; A, d > 0 with the collar bound meas{I: exists J in boundary V, ¦I-J¦ < t} <= A t for 0 < t < d (hboundary); D_t and N_s as in bpP:p4:conv#data; max norm
SOURCE_QUANTIFIERS: V, A, d fixed (data of bpP:p0:pg); then (a) t > 0, (b) 0 < t < d, (c) 0 < s < t (and s < t < d for the measure bound)

CONTRACT_ID: stepP:p10:F-C

SOURCE_QUANTIFIERS: data,c; choose a_hat, then small a_1
SOURCE_CONCLUSION: sigma_l -> delta_l (l<n), sigma_n ->0; product limit is product_d F_{c^(d)} of the smaller system, where c^(d)=((c_prime_2,...,c_prime_n); the entries of c_doubleprime with entry d deleted); the factors are matched by d=pi^(-1)(n) and pi_doubleprime=pi composed with the increasing enumeration of {1,...,n} minus {d}. If every c^(d)!=0, Fc-analytic, generic and induction give a_hat with nonzero limit. If some c^(d)=0 then c has a single nonzero secular coefficient and every factor is nonzero by definiteness

NODE: bpP:p10:stability
KIND: lemma
TITLE: Finite-order stability of the amount
STATEMENT_SOURCE: blueprint-P/parts/p10-nondegeneracy.tex#bpP:p10:stability@L222-L227
PROOF_SOURCE: blueprint-P/parts/p10-nondegeneracy.tex#bpP:p10:stability@L228-L231
CONTRACT_ID: bpP:p10:stability
CONTRACT_VERSION: 1
SOURCE_HYPOTHESES: omega,omega_tilde:B->R^m real analytic, m>=1; K compact nonempty; mu in N; M=max_{nu<=mu} sup_K abs(d^nu omega), theta=max_{nu<=mu} sup_K abs(d^nu(omega_tilde-omega))
SOURCE_QUANTIFIERS: maps,K,mu; all unit c,y in K,nu<=mu; positivity conclusion additionally assumes beta_mu(omega,K)>0 and 2^mu theta(2M+theta)<=beta_mu/2
SOURCE_CONCLUSION: difference between derivative norms of the two squared scalar products is <=2^nu theta(2M+theta); beta_mu(omega_tilde,K)>=beta_mu(omega,K)-2^mu theta(2M+theta). Under the two additional guards the new amount is >=beta_mu(omega,K)/2>0 with the same order; no nondegeneracy premise on omega_tilde. When the index is defined the positivity guard holds for every mu>=mu_0; for positive integers mu it is equivalent to mu>=mu_0
CONSTANT_SCOPE: all bounds use the displayed maps,K,mu,M,theta

SOURCE_QUANTIFIERS: for every d there are gamma > 0 and eps_adm > 0 depending only on d, such that for every d-admissible H with sup¦f¦ <= eps_f <= eps_adm: (K1)-(K6)
SOURCE_CONCLUSION: (K1) a compact H in K with meas H >= meas K - eps^*; (K2) for b in H real analytic K_b : R^N -> R^N x R^N with K_b(theta + k) = K_b(theta) + (k, 0), D K_b injective, K_b^*(dr^dtheta) = 0, injective modulo Z^N, and (gamma, tau_D)-Diophantine w_b with s -> K_b(theta + s w_b) a solution of X_H; (K3) sup¦u_b¦ <= Delta = Delta(eps_f; d); (K4) (b, theta) -> K_b(theta) injective on H x [0,1)^N, image B Borel, meas B >= 2^{-2N} meas H; (K5) lower budget: with all entries but beta fixed there is c_* > 0 with eps_adm >= c_* beta^{B_0}, B_0 = mu(mu + 1) + 2 (for 0 < beta <= min{1, M}); (K6) displacement power: c_D > 0, kappa_D > 0, a_D >= 0 with Delta <= c_D eps_f^{kappa_D} beta^{-a_D} whenever eps_f <= eps_adm and beta in (0, min{1,M}]
CONSTANT_SCOPE: gamma, eps_adm depend only on d (hence on beta through d); c_*, c_D, kappa_D, a_D depend only on the entries of d other than beta; Delta = Delta(eps_f; d)

CONTRACT_VERSION: 1
SOURCE_HYPOTHESES: E subset R^N, t>0, B = E+t, T>0, D>0; omega: B -> C^N holomorphic, real on B ∩ R^N, norm(D omega)<=L on B, t T L <= D/2 and ¦k.omega¦>=D on E for 0<¦k¦_1<=T (hypotheses of Lemma bpP:p11a:divisor-perturb); r_*>delta>0; P_0: C^N x B -> C, P_1 = (P_1,j): C^N x B -> C^N admissible trigonometric polynomials of degree <=T in theta with norm(P_0)_(r_*;B)<=M_0, norm(P_1,j)_(r_*;B)<=M_1; Lambda_delta as in sec-hom#lambda
SOURCE_QUANTIFIERS: E, t, T, D, omega, L, r_*, delta, P_0, P_1, M_0, M_1
SOURCE_CONCLUSION: there are unique admissible trigonometric polynomials phi_0, phi_1,j of degree <=T with zero average, holomorphic on C^N x B, such that omega(b).d_theta phi_0 = P_0 - <P_0>, omega(b).d_theta phi_1,j = P_1,j - <P_1,j>; (a) norm(phi_0)_(r_*-delta;B) <= Lambda_delta M_0/(pi D), likewise phi_1,j with M_1; (b) averages holomorphic on B bounded by M_0, M_1; (c) for 0<t'<t, j>=1, b in E+t', theta in T_(r_*-delta): norm(D_b^j phi_0) <= j^j Lambda_delta M_0 (pi D)^(-1) (t-t')^(-j), likewise phi_1,j, averages; (d) if P_0,P_1 are real on real points, reality for real (theta,b); (e) ¦phi^_1,j,k(b)¦ <= M_1 e^(-2 pi ¦k¦_1 r_*)/(pi D) for 0<¦k¦_1<=T; and {N_b,phi} = -(P - <P>) for phi = phi_0 + phi_1.eta, N_b = h + omega.eta, P = P_0 + P_1.eta
CONSTANT_SCOPE: phi_0, phi_1 unique given the data; constants depend only on N, delta, D, M_0, M_1

SOURCE_QUANTIFIERS: (a) for every n >= 1, every real eps, every w in O_n; (b) equality of the defined secular jets for n>=1 on their analytic domain, the R-nondegeneracy interface for n>=2, and the planar torsion comparison for n=2; (c) n = 2: mu_0 > 0 and r_0 in (0, r_*/sqrt2] arbitrary, w in the Birkhoff domain, eps real
SOURCE_CONCLUSION: (a) H_fix(Psi(w)) = h(Lambda) + eps f^_fix(w) with h, f^_fix independent of eps; Psi and h are those of H_mov; f^_fix = -G sum_{i<j} m_i m_j s_ij^{-1/2} is real analytic on Psi^{-1}(W); (b) f^_mov - f^_fix = ¦sum_i p^(i)¦^2/(2 m0), whose lambda-average is delta(Lambda) of bpP:p8:identification; all (xi,eta)-derivatives of order >= 1 of S_mov and S_fix agree, S_fix = C_0 + xi^T Q_h xi + eta^T Q_h eta + O(¦(xi,eta)¦^4), (nu, Omega = 2 sigma), Q_h, the quartic jet and the torsion beta^ are the same for both models, hence the R-nondegeneracy of (nu, Omega) with index and amount (bpP:p10:interface) holds for the fixed-Sun model; (c) P_fix := f^_fix o T on T-set (0 elsewhere): T(T-set) lies in the analyticity domain of f^_fix, P_fix is real analytic on T-set, 2pi-periodic in lambda, independent of eps, H_fix(Psi o T(w)) = h(Lambda) + eps P_fix(w) for all real eps and w in T-set, and HasBirkhoff(P_fix, int K, r_0, mu_0, P_0^fix, Omega, beta) with P_0^fix = C_0(a(I)), Omega = 2 sigma(a(I)), beta = beta^(a(I)) in the dictionary (I, phi, p, q) = (Lambda, lambda, y, x); Omega, beta coincide with the moving-Sun data and P_0^mov - P_0^fix = delta
CONSTANT_SCOPE: h, f^_fix independent of eps; the Birkhoff objects depend only on (G, m0, m, K_a), not on f nor on eps; delta depends on Lambda only

NODE: bpP:p14:elements
KIND: lemma
TITLE: Elements of one planet
STATEMENT_SOURCE: blueprint-P/parts/p14a-amd-expsafe.tex#bpP:p14:elements@L42-L53
PROOF_SOURCE: blueprint-P/parts/p14a-amd-expsafe.tex#bpP:p14:elements@L54-L64
CONTRACT_ID: bpP:p14:elements
CONTRACT_VERSION: 1
SOURCE_HYPOTHESES: m > 0; (q,p) in R^2 x R^2 with r = ¦q¦ > 0, E = ¦p¦^2/(2m) - m/r < 0 and C = cr(q,p) > 0; a = -m/(2E), Lambda = m sqrt(a), e-vector = (¦p¦^2/m^2 - 1/r) q - (q.p)/m^2 p, e = ¦e-vector¦ (Definition d25-kepler)
SOURCE_QUANTIFIERS: m; (q,p); then a, Lambda, e-vector, e determined
SOURCE_CONCLUSION: (a) a > 0, Lambda > 0, Lambda^2 = m^2 a, E = -m^3/(2 Lambda^2); (b) e^2 = 1 - C^2/Lambda^2, hence 0 < C <= Lambda, 0 <= e < 1, C = Lambda sqrt(1-e^2); (c) q.e-vector = C^2/m^2 - r = a(1-e^2) - r; (d) a(1-e) <= r <= a(1+e); (e) ¦p¦^2 < 2m^2/r; (f) Lambda - C = Lambda(1 - sqrt(1-e^2)) >= 0, and Lambda - C >= Lambda(1 - sqrt(1-e'^2)) whenever e >= e' in [0,1)
